purpose: Desktop announcements tag leather material with visible edging
crop_policy: Lower leather crop preserves both side stitches, the bottom seam, rounded foot and visible outer edging; the top continues beyond the attached tag.
alpha_mask: Top square, bottom radius 56 output pixels; transparent lower corners reveal the terracotta CSS fallback.
fallback: The CSS background-color #98401f remains under the transparent WebP and paints immediately if the image is pending or fails.
